page: Amazon Web Services i8ge.metal-24xl is a storage-optimized bare-metal server powered by the AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 architecture. It features 96 physical cores and 96 vCPUs operating at 2.8 GHz with no hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of DDR5 memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 150 Gbps. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 60,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, while no GPU accelerators are present.

In benchmark testing, the server demonstrates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, particularly in stress-ng multi-core tests and Geekbench multi-core workloads. The DDR5 memory subsystem achieves top-tier read and write bandwidth across both small cached and large uncached blocks. Database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput also rank in the top tier. However, single-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench remains in the average tier, and LLM text generation for small models is relatively weak, though text generation for medium and large models ranks in the strong tier.

The bare-metal ARM64 architecture provides high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive local storage and high memory throughput without the overhead of virtualization. Given the combination of 60 TB of local NVMe SSD storage, top-tier database benchmarks, and high memory bandwidth, this server is optimized for large-scale databases, Redis caching layers, high-throughput web serving, and multi-threaded data processing tasks.
